chapterInfo.content:
34
AWURADE adɔeɛ ne n’ayamyɛ ho dwom
Dawid deɛ a ɔtoeɛ berɛ a ɔdanee sɛ ɔbɔdamfoɔ Abimelek anim na ɔpamm no maa no kɔeɛ no.
1 # 1 Sa 21.13-15 Mɛhyira AWURADE nna nyinaa,
n’ayeyie wɔ m’anomu daa yi.
2AWURADE mu na me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho,
ahobrɛasefoɔ bɛte, na wɔn ani agye.
3Mo ne me nkamfo AWURADE kɛseyɛ,
na momma yɛmmom mma ne din so.
4Mahwehwɛ AWURADE, na wabua me,
na wagye me afiri deɛ mesuro nyinaa mu.
5Wɔn a wɔhwɛɛ no no anim tee,
na wɔn anim angu ase.
6Ohiani yi teaa mu, na AWURADE tiee no,
na ɔgyee no n’ahohia nyinaa mu.
7 # Gye 32.1; Dwom 91.11 AWURADE bɔfoɔ bɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no ho nsraban hyia,
na ɔgye wɔn.
8 # 1 Pe 2.3 Monka nhwɛ na monhunu sɛ AWURADE yɛ,
nhyira ne onipa a ɔdwane kɔtoa no.
9 # Dwom 37.19 AWURADE akronkronfoɔ, monsuro no!
na biribiara remmɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no.
10 # Dwom 33.18-19; 37.25; Luka 1.53 Gyata mmuruwa bɛdi hia na ɛkɔm ade wɔn,
na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ AWURADE no adepa biara remmɔ wɔn.
11Mma, mommra, monyɛ aso mma me!
Mɛkyerɛ mo AWURADE suro.
12 # 1 Pe 3.10-12 Mo mu hwan na ɔhwehwɛ nkwa,
na ɔpɛ onyinkyerɛ sɛ ɔbɛhunu papa?
13Kora wo tɛkyerɛma, bɔne ho,
ɛne w’ano, nnaadaasɛm ho.
14 # Dwom 37.27 Yi bɔne ho akwa, na yɛ papa,
hwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ, na ti no.
15AWURADE ani wɔ ateneneefoɔ so,
na n’aso tie wɔn sufrɛ.
16 # Mmb 10.7 AWURADE ani sa nnebɔneyɛfoɔ,
sɛ ɔbɛhye wɔn ase, asase so.
17Ateneneefoɔ su frɛ, na AWURADE tie,
na ɔgye wɔn firi wɔn ahohia nyinaa mu.
18 # Dwom 51.17 AWURADE bɛn wɔn a wɔn akoma abubuo,
na ɔgye wɔn a wɔn honhom apɛkyɛ.
19 # 2 Ko 1.5 Ɔteneneeni amaneɛ dɔɔso,
na AWURADE gye no ne nyinaa mu.
20Ɔhwɛ ne nnompe nyinaa,
sɛdeɛ emu baako mpo mmu.
21Bɔne bɛkum ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔtane ɔteneneeni no bɛbrɛ mu.
22AWURADE gye ne nkoa kra,
na wɔn a wɔdwane kɔtoa no nyinaa wɔremmu wɔn fɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
